topic: Everest summit on the Nepal-China border
hook: Your Everest summit photo is also a border photo.
title: Your Everest Summit Photo Is a Border Photo
description:
The border between Nepal and China runs across the top of Mount Everest. Stand on the summit and you are on the line between two countries. Everest is 8,849 metres tall. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Everest #Geography
